items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were in the band with Goodman when Fats Navarro played in the band, the trumpet player? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I know he liked Fats Waller.

Fats, oh, yes. Yes. There were a couple of -- oh, a couple of other idols. Another one of his idols, you didn't hear very much about him --a pianist then was from Princeton, New Jersey. His name was Donald -- Don Lambert.
